recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If PA or Gender Harmony wants direct base-spec LOINC mapping language for laboratory biological sex again, that should be a new work-group decision coordinated with the Gender Harmony IG and extension-pack content rather than a replay of this STU3 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-14755 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification STU3 Patient issue asking for laboratory-relevant biological sex/gender handling, including proposed LOINC mappings for 76689-9 Sex assigned at birth and 76691-5 Gender identity when Administrative Gender is not clinically reliable. The final disposition was to clarify and extend the Patient Gender section, refer to FHIR-14756, and note that relevant sex/gender observations could be included on the lab order through ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly naming FHIR-14755 was found. The contemporaneous Patient sex/gender issue family was applied through nearby commits: #14482 rewrote the Patient Gender and Sex section, b7d0f473c3 applied #14754/#14719 by improving clinical gender Observation guidance with LOINC 76691-5, and 42c4df50f2 applied FHIR-14756 by adding LOINC 76689-9 Observation guidance for sex assigned at birth.
additional_context: Later Patient Administration/Gender Harmony work changed the representation model. FHIR-29673 introduced Sex for Clinical Use/Sex Parameter for Clinical Use and Recorded Sex or Gender guidance, while FHIR-39203 moved exchange recommendations out of the FHIR base Patient narrative and into the Gender Harmony IG. The current Patient Gender and Sex section says Patient.gender is administrative, directs clinical sex-characteristic observations to Observation with clinical codes, points Gender Identity/SPCU/RSG/SAAB concepts to standard extensions or the Gender Harmony IG, and warns that sex assigned at birth can be a poor proxy for current clinical sex. ServiceRequest.supportingInfo remains the lab-order path for additional observations. FHIR-14756 is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit a202416e13.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Restoring the old direct LOINC mapping text or adding new lab-specific Patient prose would duplicate or partially reverse later Gender Harmony decisions; the current build already conveys that Patient.gender is not clinically authoritative and that relevant observations or extension/IG mechanisms should be used.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification Patient issue asking for laboratory-relevant sex/gender guidance and proposed LOINC mappings for 76689-9 and 76691-5.
evidence_items.learned: The final decision was clarification, referral to FHIR-14756, and use of ServiceRequest.supportingInfo rather than binding Patient.gender to those LOINC codes.

evidence_items.summary: Patient is an active resource, and the current Patient Gender and Sex section separates administrative gender, gender identity, SPCU, clinical observations, RSG, legal sex, and sex assigned at birth.
evidence_items.learned: The build-scoped Patient guidance already preserves the clinically relevant distinction without reusing the old direct mapping text.
